verdict.rationale: Monitoring entity standing and filing deadlines is a fair question for a registered-agent and compliance service, so the axis applies. The pack has no first-party content: the site returned a Cloudflare challenge at robots.txt, and the only community item is an unrelated SEO remark. There is no evidence of an API, webhook, or programmatic deadline alerts.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can watch entity standing and filing deadlines through an API or webhook and raise them before they lapse
